This is a pedal I describe as an Analog amp emulator. The project came about initially as we were asked to create a pedal that emulated a rare amp called the Selmer Treble and Bass 50. The player in question (Lee Harris - Saucerful of Secrets) wanted a pedal to provide him with the vintage amp tones Syd Barret used in early Pink Floyd music. This was so that he could sound authentic whilst playing on the Saucerful of Secrets World Tour. Fitted with a high-quality, custom audio transformer, this pedal breathes, reacts, and distorts with the exact feel and dynamic response of a full-sized tube amplifier. The Origin of a Legend: The Syd Barrett Tone Originally commissioned by Lee Harris (Saucerful of Secrets) to authentically replicate the elusive vintage amp tones of Pink Floyd’s Syd Barrett, the Scarlet Tunic was born to emulate the rare Selmer Treble and Bass 50. ThorpyFX nailed the Selmer tone, but pushed the design even further. This powerhouse pedal now successfully captures the unmistakable chime of a Vox AC30 and the muscular headroom of a Hiwatt DR103, giving you a stadium-ready vintage amp arsenal in a single enclosure. Seamless Integration Tested extensively on world tour stages, the Scarlet Tunic is built to deliver unmatched reliability and tone. Whether you are using it to push an existing amp, stacking it with your favorite drive pedals, or building a brand-new signature sound, this pedal integrates flawlessly into any modern rig. Comprehensive Tone Sculpting Controls Dial in your perfect amp-in-a-box tone using the highly responsive control layout: Master: Controls the overall volume output.
